windows_desktop_connection.note: Windows ZCode 3.16.2 connected after applying the SSH command-wrapper fix.

windows_project_operations.note: Open project, create/edit files, terminal creation, file/content search, and Git status.

task_persistence_after_disconnect.note: A short task completed and its result was confirmed after desktop disconnect/reconnect.

isolated_live_update_rollback.note: Real daemons, post-activation failure, successful rollback, corrupt recovery archive, and explicit repair. The next archive changes only gzip metadata around the same verified payload.

isolated_crash_recovery.note: Recovery after killing only temporary server processes, retaining stale run files, and starting again over SSH; daemon remained ready after SSH disconnect. This was not a host reboot.

host_reboot.note: Not performed. The user explicitly excluded host reboot from this acceptance scope.

limitations: Pin the desktop to ZCode 3.16.2; the probe contains no client version.
Preinstall and update using the remote helper, not the desktop installer.
Host reboot was not tested and was explicitly excluded by the user; no reboot recovery guarantee is claimed.
